verdict: Leads surged this period; converting them to cases is the next hurdle.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 82 leads at a cost of $22.04 per lead — a 33% drop in cost per lead compared to the prior 7-day period, driven by the August Re-Launch campaign scaling spend on Meta. Lead volume itself jumped 300% week-over-week, and the most recent three days show that momentum continuing to accelerate. The open question is what happens after a lead arrives: no opportunities have been logged in your CRM this period, which means the cost per signed case remains unknown and intake speed is the constraint to watch. SMS automation and voice access are being set up to close that gap, with CRM auto-logging and case tracking targeted for live status by end of September.
